notes.title: Pet Exchange Event
notes.notes:
Pet Trade-In Event

Join GM_ZenDragoon today at 10:30  AM EST for our next limited pet trade-in event and this one is a special! When the event begins, GM_ZenDragoon will announce an Entry Character in Eversun City about half hour before the official event begins at approximately 11:00 AM EST, so show up at 10:30 AM EST to sign up. Once players are notified of the entry character, players must whisper that character to qualify for the Pet Exchange event! The first 50 lucky players to whisper the Entry Character will be able to trade in 3 pets under the follow conditions:

[Original, SE1 - SE8]
- Any 3 pets may be traded in for any 1 Level 11 Original, SE1-SE8 pet
- Any Ruby or Lily pet exchanges must contain a Ruby or Lily pet in return

[SE9 - SE14]
- Any 3 pets EXCEPT for Original Metal pets can be exchanged for a SE 9 - SE14 pet
- Any Ruby or Lily pet exchanges must contain a Ruby or Lily pet in return

[S1 - S4] (No trading for S5's this event)
- Any 3 pets EXCEPT for Original Metal pets can be exchanged for a S pet
- Must include at least ONE S pet in the exchange
- Any Ruby or Lily pet exchanges must contain a Ruby or Lily pet in return

[Dragon and Kuku]
- Must contain either (a) Dragon and a Kuku Pet or (b) two Dragon Pets or (b) two Kuku pets. The third pet can be anything.
- The third pet must NOT contain an Original Metal Pet.

[Special Pets] (Lion King, Dragon, Mecha Bird, Ox, Shadow Antelope, etc.)
- Trade 2 of the Ultimate Pets + 1 other non-ultimate pet for the pet that you choose.
- Can also be 3 ultimate pets if needed

[Vanity Pets]
- Trade 3 Vanity Pets for any vanity pet of your choice, including SE

Once you've identified the transaction you want to make, players must wait patiently for the GM's to go through the list of players.

Rules:
1) PLEASE adhere to the conditions above. The GM may skip and come back to you if you don't have the correct transaction.
2) No kukus or dragons when trading for SE or S pets
3) 1 Lily must be traded in alongside 2 other pets for any Lily
4) 1 Ruby must be traded in alongside 2 other pets for any SE Ruby, but any 3 pets can be traded in for an Original Ruby
5) For anything that's not an original or SE1-8 pet, players can NOT use original metal pets. Something like this is acceptable for example: SE2 Metal, Original Sapphire, SE3 Jade for SE10 Sapphire
6) Please know which pets you wish to exchange for before you are called to a GM to quicken the process. If you are not ready, the GM might pass up your turn and you might lose out on the opportunity to do the exchange.
7) Once the designated character has been announced, players must whisper their entry ONCE to the designated player as quickly as possible. DO NOT excessively whisper the designated character. The GM's find this annoying and WILL disqualify you for hassling them. Also, DO NOT whisper the Entry account with questions because then it's more difficult to run the event and qualify people for the exchange.
8) There is a limit of 50 people. Once there are 50 people queued, we will announce that we have stopped entries and will announce the participants.
9) If the event concludes and your name was not called, we didn't forget you, we just only have room for 50 entrants. Out of respect for the qualifying people, please do not make a fuss in chat. The GM will take action.

Process:
1) GM will announce the name of the Entry Account and will say "Entrance process is now open" at 10:30 AM EST.
2) After we collect 50 entries, we scan the accounts for any duplicate entries and other things that might determine if someone qualifies or not.
3) Once GM's are ready to do the pet exchange, we teleport players to us to begin the transaction. Make sure that you have everything ready beforehand otherwise we will have to move to the next entrant.
3) Please be quick when trading the GM and allow him to initiate the trade first just in case if the GM needs to make any quick preparations.
5) Once the exchange is finished, the GM will warp you back to Eversun. Please do not ask the GM any questions and minimize the small talk as we have a lot of people to go through.

Date: Thursday, October 8th at 10:30 AM EST
Time: 10:30 AM EST for sign-up, 11:00 AM EST (approximately. Might be a bit later depending on how long it takes for us to prepare the list) for the exchange.

notes.title: NEW: Housing System + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we apologize for the long maintenance but we are happy to announce that we have launched a new patch that introduces a brand new House System! This is a relatively big patch so I have broken it up into two parts. First part is explaining the House and Furniture System and the Second part includes all other patch notes that were included in the update.

===========================================

With this system, players can own their own residence and decorate it and expand it to their own liking to give themselves a proper home and level of comfort that they may not have ever felt in DOMO.
Players first may buy a Private Residence Property via the City Group Residence NPC located in Eversun City at x127, y263. After paying off the down payment, players may then be granted access to their very own home. Once access has been permitted, players then acquire the ability to immediately teleport to their House via a button that is available next to their character information on the Status Screen.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/0666b5d60951a514e0ef4d45687c88868a9e5622.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/b2f0ddbda7b28a4b62812e63aeec9a59ff308a9f.png[/img][/url]

Once inside your House, it may be empty but we can fill it shortly. You have two stone NPC's at the very corner of the house. The one on the Left grants you access to a Second Floor (Will be available tomorrow) and the one on the right gives you the options to Leave the Residence, view Hidden items, Toggle Designer Mode between Normal Mode, Flooring Setting, Wallpaper Setting, and also the ability to pay off your loan for the rest of the house granting you the ability to expand.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/9fee1300f6637c71e32fb3e3d26f6c9c2aef06e9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/c866980b339c54fdce3d79ee23d4937a7fcc927c.png[/img][/url]

At the City Group Residences NPC, players can purchase alchemy scrolls with in-game gold that allows them to craft furniture to decorate their homes with. Once in your home, we will explain the following:
First if you are decorating, you will want to toggle Designer Mode via the Stone NPC in the right corner of your House. Once toggled, you are able to stand anywhere in the house, and clicking on any furniture you have crafted will allow you to place the furniture. It is important to note that at this time, players should have Designer Mode on when placing items because when placed, they will be trapped inside the item (will be fixed in an upcoming date). But if Designer Mode is on, players can then click on the furniture they placed and can move it around the house, rotate it and can click Confirm once they have finalized where they want it to go without getting stuck. If designer mode is off, players will have to log out and log back in and will find themselves back in Eversun City. We are currently waiting for a way to get get around that from the developers so hopefully this shouldn't be a problem for players by next week.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/2ef8dbd886a086b1aab06ea7c043a05910235848.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/0b6266919059015fd0543b36a0f4dd3774bbf85a.png[/img][/url]

If players want to temporarily hide items or move them more easily, as long as the player is in Designer Mode, players will then have the option to click on items and Hide them. In order for players to place them again, they need to go to the stone npc in the right corner, click on Hidden Items and then the menu gives the player to freely move around the room. Players then can find an appropriate place to place the hidden item and when they are ready they can click whichever furniture they want that is in the hidden list to place the item.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/17a1a9bde4f89c0f21efe3db1590118827d0cc0b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8284617/c5d35f4df6a2b523ef3c4be942117d190384e78e.png[/img][/url]

Hopefully this properly explains what players can expect from this system as well as how to use it. If this is still confusing, we are working on a video that will be published tomorrow that fully explains how the House system works.
Tomorrow we are introducing even more luxurious furniture that can be purchased as well as expansions to their house so that players can fully maximize their designs.

===========================================

Onto the patch notes! Sorry for all the text but hopefully we don't leave out any details. Please view the following additional patch notes below:
-Taunt and Mock Monsters effect is increased when skill is upgraded
-Adjusted the rule for Magic Skill and Physical Skill to make them consistent.（In original rule, buffer of M.ATK was referenced to ATK, new rule now references to M.ATK）. What this means is that in some instances monster’s Magic Skill will change because of their M.ATK value. This also affects the following classes and their skills:
  All Fencer Elemental Attack skills.               
   Musician： Sonic Swipe
   Witch Doctor： Bloodthirsty Bug, Agony Bug, Explosive Bug, Liquid Venom,    Poison Fog
Doctor： Health Heist, Heavy Health Heist
All other job skills that are not listed have not been impacted.
-Improved all ATK skill effects for Blademaster
-Improve Blademaster’s Toughen Magic and Offensive Aura skill effects.
We are also currently waiting for an update on Challenger Title Scroll not being usable, Madame Malachite raid not being able to be done, Wester Tiger Billboard bug as well as fixes and changes to the Lightning Spirit Raid. We hope to have an update that we can test by later this week in time for us to apply it next Tuesday.

We apologize for the lengthy patch notes and lengthy maintenance but we will also have more to announce by tomorrow. Stay tuned!

We would like to formally announce a contest in which we are looking for someone to help us design a monthly event calendar! If you have experience with using art programs, we'd love to see you showcase your art! For this contest, we'd like to challenge players to design an event calendar for the month of April. 

As a reminder, this month's events are:
April 2nd: GM Jailer
April 9th: Easter Egg Hunt
April 16th: Pet Fashion Event
April 23rd: Boss Rush Event
April 30th: Hide and Seek

The winner will receive 15000 SP monthly for every month they design an event calendar. This contest won't run for long as we plan on announcing a winner by April 16th or even as early as the 9th on the day of the Easter Egg Hunt depending on the number of quality entries.

To submit your entry, submit them here on Steam. Good luck and we look forward to seeing your talent on display!

notes.title: PSA on Exploiting Events
notes.notes:
This is a reminder that we do not tolerate cheating and using alt accounts to exploit our GM run events. We did a thorough investigation of our logs during the DOMO Potluck event and found well over a dozen players using several alts to exploit the event. While we're still deciding on whether or not to punish the players at fault, but do know that we check our logs after events and any players. Any players using multiple accounts for future events will result in rewards being stripped from the accounts and the accounts being suspended.

Our events are run with the intention of it being fun, fair, inclusive, and to reward players sufficiently without it being damaging to the game. Exploiting those rewards endangers our ability to run events with great rewards. And we don't want it to come to that.

Thank you all for your understanding and thank you to all who choose to play fair.

notes.title: Broadcast Chat Behavior
notes.notes:
We would like to remind all players that while players are free to use broadcast channel, we expect everyone to conduct themselves in a respectful manner using that chat channel. Broadcast chat sets the tone for the DOMO community. For new players, the conduct of Broadcast chat can be the determining factor of whether they stay or leave. The same could be said for veteran players as well.

We will NOT tolerate the following behavior in broadcast chat:
-Inappropriate/sexual content
-Hateful/racist/misogynist content and claims
-Heavy topics that incite anger such as political, geographical, etc. topics
-Mob mentality witch hunts

Failure to properly represent DOMO in broadcast chat WILL result in account suspensions. We wish to be as inclusive as possible by making sure that everyone is comfortable when playing DOMO. Also, failure to conduct yourself in respectful fashion in the PAS system WILL result in even harsher bans as everyone in the server can see these messages.

Please do the right thing and help us make DOMO a more friendly and welcoming community.

Regards,
GM Team

Next Thursday (December 20th) we are holding a Secret Santa event in DOMO. This operates differently from how you would normally do Secret Santa.

notes.title: Update for September 4th: VIP Map, Refresh System + More!
notes.notes:
We have launched a new patch today. Please review the patch notes below:

1. Introducing a new VIP membership! When players purchase VIP membership, they acquire a Teleport Key which gives them unlimited access to an exclusive VIP map for 30 days.  This VIP map gives VIP access to several NPC’s and services:
-Access to VIP Seizer’s Palace. The items given in the VIP Seizer Palace are much different than Eversun’s. While it gives less Casino Night tokens, players get higher quality rare rewards such as better onyx’s and permanent costume vouchers.
-NPC that teleports players anywhere they desire which acts as infinite Go-Anywhere’s
-NPC that teleports players to any collection area of their choosing
-VIP exclusive gathering areas scattered throughout the VIP map
-Merchant NPC’s such as Shady Dealer, Pet Shop, Collection Tools, etc. offer their wares at a 20% discount.
-Includes Bank, Mailbox, Yinglong’s Weapon fragment exchange, Clever King’s Secretary for added convenience.
-Several Pets found throughout the game can be found roaming around the VIP map for vanity purposes.

2. A Refresh Merchant NPC can now be found in Eversun City (x113, y267) which introduces the refresh system. This system allows players to change the stats of their upgraded/modded legendary set equipment. Players must first acquire a refresh stone to reroll the stats on the equipment, and can choose to purchase lock stones to lock the other stats in place. Using this system also doesn’t reset the modded levels on the upgraded equipment so that players don’t feel that their equipment mods went to waste.

3. Black Tiger II Alchemy Scroll allows players to use alchemy on two white tigers to create a Black Tiger II pet

4. Set Onyxes no longer work in non-set pieces.

5. Vermilion Crystals from the Southern Vermilion Raid now comes in a bag like other raids.

6. Yinlongs Inventory has now been updated.

We will leave it up to players to discover what the criteria will be to win each category. All costumes to enter the Fashion Event can be permanent and temporary.

notes.title: Maintenance has Concluded + Item Mall update
notes.notes:
Maintenance has concluded and players may now log back in. We've applied an Item Mall update patch that features a new twist on permanent costume Lucky Boxes. Not only did we add Animal and Valentine's Lucky boxes, we added "Fortune Box" variations of them for a limited time.

"What's a Fortune Box?" you say? Well, it it operates just like a lucky box. However, when players get a costume voucher from it (The chances to acquire one is the exact same), they have the freedom to select whatever item they want from the voucher instead of it being completely random. The price of the fortune boxes are a bit higher than the lucky box versions but with the added benefit of getting whatever you want from the box.

Voucher contents can be found here:
https://forum.subagames.com/showthread.php?t=124343

notes.title: Spooktober Event Calendar
notes.notes:
Here is your Event Calendar for Spooktober! All event times are at 2:00 PM EDT. 1:00 PM EDT will be the start of the Halloween Costume Party Event. 

[IMG]https://scontent-yyz1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t31.0-8/22137188_1934585916811796_1102021423787584460_o.png?oh=a49210666a681aa9ecf44885126ddc2c&oe=5A401106[/IMG]

Here are the descriptions for every event:

GM Wrath: Players face the wrath of the GMs as they drop the game's hardest monsters in frightening numbers as they strive to survive the onslaught and find the NPC who gives out Event Stamps
Hide and Seek: A GM hides on a map and players must try and be the first one to locate the GM to win a prize
GM Jailor: The GM hunts down all tplayers in the event and tries to jail all of them. The ones that escape the GM's grasp, wins a prize.
Halloween Event: STAY TUNED FOR SOME SPOOKY SURPRISES! DETAILS COMING SOON!
Halloween Costume Party: On the day of event, players line up to try and gain access to a private Halloween party that the GM's are having. Entry is simple: Wear a Halloween Costume set that is on the Halloween Item Mall tab.

notes.title: DOMO Version 21 is now LIVE
notes.notes:
The next big update for DOMO, Version 21, is now LIVE! Please view the patch notes for the update below:

-Weapon cosmetics are now available! Change how your weapon looks with the weapon skins that you can get in the Balls and Toys & Food and Love boxes.
-We've added two new passive buffs through the wardrobe system when you store costumes at 210 pieces and 245 pieces
-We'd also added Wardrobe Expansion Scroll VIII to item mall
-Modded 20/20 costumes will now sparkle when worn.
-New NPC - Modeling Consultant -> Exchange your costume weapons to become a Modeling Weapon!
-New quest - League of Pinballs (Note: We're aware of typos in this quest, this will be fixed next week. Sorry!)
-New NPC - Rebrander NPC - This NPC will allow you to rename weapons! The item required will be released later.
-The Wardrobe now has categories to see specific costume parts such as hats, bodies, back pieces, etc.
-NEW NPC: Yinglong - Sells various titles and new True Weapon Fragments for raid tokens- Collect 10 fragments to make a true 70 weapon! Raid tokens can be obtained from Trial Tower in Academy of Mirrors
-Added revamped SE 3 Kuku box
-Trial Tower loot in Academy of Mirrors has been readjusted.

Previews of Balls and Toys weapons: [URL="http://imgur.com/a/QuCYC"]http://imgur.com/a/QuCYC[/URL]
Previews of Love and Food weapons: [URL="http://imgur.com/a/CcTLJ"]http://imgur.com/a/CcTLJ[/URL]

notes.title: Gambling at Seizer's Palace with one or more account at a time will get you BANNED
notes.notes:
We have caught quite a few players multiclienting Seizer's Palace mule farming Casino Night tickets. We are banning players that we catch doing this. This is also breaking our rules that we've put in place of running more than one account at a time. Simply read the rules. Exploiting events such as this may result in them not being run in the future. Don't ruin this for the people who participate in this event legally. Players that fail to heed this warning will be facing harsher punishment including permanent suspension of accounts. 

We'd also like to take this time to thank all those players who participate in our events with a legal means. You make these events very fun for us to run. You know who you are and we appreciate that you set a good example for the community. Thank you.

notes.title: June Event Calendar
notes.notes:
Here is your Event Calendar for June! All events are taking place on Thursdays at 2:00 PM EDT. 

[IMG]https://scontent-yyz1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/18740585_1877016559235399_8297709477339970451_n.jpg?oh=c27c18566ffe20267237ed187d4b1e7e&oe=59BA092C[/IMG]

Here is the run down of each event:

Thursday June 1st: Paparazzi Event - The GM runs away from players as they try and get the best screenshot of the GM as possible. Participants are to then upload their entries on the forums where the GM then judges which ones are the best.

Thursday June 8th: An event we've never done before! Three GM's do battle with one another and players may either decide which GM to ally with or decide to be all caught up in the cross fire as chaos ensues.

Thursday June 15th: A low level and high level boss rush event is held where players do battle with wave after wave of the game's toughest monsters!

Thursday June 22nd: Players run from the GM as the GM tries to jail every single player on the event map. The ones that manage to evade him or hide well enough win a prize!

Thursday June 29th: Collect as many Casino Night tickets as you can from gambling at Seizar's Palace and exchange them for prizes that are setup outside the building. This may be setup at an earlier hour than scheduled and runs for a few hours for player's convenience.

notes.title: Your Support Needed!
notes.notes:
DOMO needs your help in our quest to get more players to join the community!

It will only take 5 seconds of your time and will goes a long way in helping DOMO.  
 
We’ve partnered with Thunderclap to promote DOMO in hope of bringing more players to our beloved game. 

A brief explanation on how this works… Thunderclap is an app that updates everyone’s status or twitter/feed who have joined the particular thunderclap at the same time on the same day. It only happens once and won’t spam your friends. But the end result is massive amounts of people are reached. 

Is up to you whether more people will know about DOMO. Interested in joining the cause? Please click:  http://thndr.me/b3qrL4

Thank you for your support as always!

notes.title: Emergency Maintenance for March 21st has concluded
notes.notes:
Maintenance has concluded. We have applied a patch that not only fixes the Trader girl issue that was resulting in players getting stuck, but a few other things well.

-Players are no longer force to go back to the last Spooky Bottom instance when they leave the instance. It now gives them the choice to go anywhere else.

-Fixed issue where doing Instanced quests, such as Mirror Sprite or T2 quests, or being in fireworks maps sometimes gives players titles that they do not have. These titles are not equippable and disappear after changing maps or logging off.

-To combat the Gold Spammers and Gold Sellers, we have imposed a trade and broadcast channel restriction. This becomes unlocked once the character completes the Lever 15 mission; Learn to Fly.

notes.title: Maintenance has concluded + Patch notes
notes.notes:
Maintenance has concluded and players may now log back in. Please see the patch notes below:

-We've made changes to the 5 elements where players can have more than 100 elemental attack. Note: Because we are still attempting to make further changes to the magic system, we hope players can help give feedback in regards to the changes and what's left for us to change.
-We implemented a sending stone that not only can teleport players to certain mobs on Spooky Bottom but also can create private instances. ***However upon testing, the private instances are bugged where players can't leave until after 6 hours or until their spooky bottom key runs out. If players decide that they want to leave, they need to relog. Please use at own risk.***
-In order to combat gold sellers and other malicious activity in DOMO, there is now a requirement to access Item Mall. Players must be at least level 10 and log a total of 12 game time hours. We may make changes to this depending on feedback but we feel that it is important to battle one the biggest issues we are facing right now.
-We've implemented the following changes to the guild merchants:

Guild Merchant I

Magic Recovery Pill - 5 guild coins (Original Price: 47)
Attack Speed Pill - 5 guild coins (Original Price: 97)
Regeneration Pill - 5 guild coins (Original Price:47)
fighting Luck Pill - 5 guild coins (Original Price:23)
Racial Transformation Scroll - 10 guild coins (Original Price:175)
Basic Fireworks 1 - 2 guild coins (Original Price: 25 guild coins)
Basic Fireworks 2 - 2 guild coins (Original Price: 25 guild coins)
Basic Fireworks 3 - 2 guild coins (Original Price: 25 guild coins)
Basic Fireworks 4 - 2 guild coins (Original Price: 25 guild coins)
Basic Fireworks 5 - 2 guild coins (Original Price: 25 guild coins)
Basic Fireworks 6 - 2 guild coins (Original Price: 25 guild coins)
Tribute - 5 guild coins (Original price: 5 guild coins)

Guild Merchant II

Lilliput Pill - 5 (Original Price: 23 guild coins)
Giant Pill - 5 (Original Price: 23 guild coins)
Spirit Catching Orb - 750 (Original Price: 1500 guild coins)
Weapon Downgrade Stone - 35 (Original Price: 300 guild coins)
Armor Downgrade Stone - 35 (Original Price: 60 guild coins)
Devil Sealing Card - 15 (Original Price: 60 guild coins)

Guild Merchant III

Insurance Scroll upgrade - 37 (Original Price: 75 guild coins)
Insurance Scroll mod - 37 (Original Price: 37 guild coins)

notes.title: Arena - Multiclienting Abuse
notes.notes:
We've noticed that there have been a concerning number of players who have been multi-clienting arena which is a bannable offense. To prevent this from being abused any further in the future, after today we'll be increasing the ban sentence to a month as we want to legitimize the Arena system. We greatly appreciate all the hard work of players who have reported those who have been abusing this.

Best Regards,
GM Team

notes.title: February Event Calendar
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here is your event calendar for February!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ejUYlMz.jpg[/IMG]

All events will be taking place at 2:00 PM EST

GM Jailer: February 2nd at 1:00 PM EST

Players must run and hide from a GM as the GM runs around jailing all players on the event map. Those who escape the GM's watchful eye, wins a prize!

GM Escort Mission: February 9th at 2:00 PM EST

Players must escort the GM from Darkdale to the snowy peaks of Sneaky Peek. But plenty of dangerous beasts monsters lie in wait on the mountain! But players must protect the GM as death will bring the event to an end prematurely.

Paparazzi Event: February 16th at 2:00 PM EST

The GM runs around on an event map avoiding the gaze of the public eye as players track down the GM and take screenshots of the GM. Scoring is awarded based off of the best quality pictures

Boss Rush Event: February 23rd at 2:00 PM EST

A low level and High level boss rush event is held to test players strength as the GM summons a gauntlet of the game's toughest enemies!

notes.title: December Event Calendar
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, here is your event calendar for the month of December!

Thursday, December 1st  @ 2:00 PM EST - Paparazzi Event
Thursday, December 8th  @ 2:00 PM EST - Hide and Seek
Thursday, December 15th @ 2:00 PM EST - GM Snowball Event
Thursday, December 22nd @ 1:00 PM EST - Christmas Scavenger Hunt
Friday, December 23rd through Christmas weekend - Secret Santa Event
Thursday, December 29th @ 2:00 PM EST - GM Wrath

Here are the details of each event:

=Paparazzi Event=
A GM runs away from players as they try and chase down the GM. When the GM is in eye sight, the player MUST take a screenshot of the GM and post it in a thread that the GM sets up. The top 10 submissions win a prize! The submissions are based off of (A) How close the GM is to the player (B) If the GM is facing towards the player (C) The general quality of the picture.

=Hide and Seek=
A GM hides from the players and the first player to find the GM and trade him will win a prize

=GM Snowball Event=
This event is similar to GM Jailer but instead of jailing players, the GM throws a special kind of snowball that freezes players in place. The remaining players win a prize!

=Christmas Scavenger Hunt=
Players must go on a scavenger hunt that takes them all over the world.Players must also solve puzzles in order to get to the end of the event to find the prize of the event.

=Secret Santa Event=
We are having another Secret Santa event like we held last year! We're completely revising the prizes that we did last year. We'll have signups for the event opening on December 2nd which will include details of the event.

=GM Wrath=
On an event map, a GM spawns the game's hardest enemies while players must run around and visit NPC's that the GM spawns in random areas of the map to collect event stamps. The NPC's spawns only stick around for a couple of minutes so players must be on the move!

notes.title: ATTN: Player Submitted Images via support tickets
notes.notes:
We greatly appreciate the assistance we get from players via the support tickets. Any bug reports, player reports, etc., goes a long way with keeping DOMO running smoothly. But we'd also like to take this time to kindly ask players for all future tickets if images sent to us can be uploaded to imgur.com

The reason why we're asking of this is that sites such as photobucket and others have plenty of pop-up ads which slows down the process of us viewing the images and even in some cases, we can't view the images at all as we're too busy closing ads. We want to safely view player submitted images in a quick manner in order to support players and the game better and faster. With imgur.com, image viewing is instantaneous and there are no ads that need to be closed before we can view it.

We greatly appreciate any efforts that is done to help us with this and we can ensure that ticket responses can be quicker if we can have cooperation on this.

Best Regards,
GM Team

~GM Team

notes.title: Version 9 is now LIVE
notes.notes:
Version 9 is now LIVE! Here are what players can log in and discover:

-ADDED Academy of Mirrors: Sprites have gone wild and have been corrupted in the halls of this academy. It is up to you to cleanse the halls of the Academy and bring everyone back to their senses.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Pkosejs.png?1[/IMG]

-ADDED Reincarnation System: Increase your potential by being born again (Back to level 10) but with the added benefit of an additional attribute point every few levels. We've also added an extra twist to this system where players can unlock the powers of transforming into a powerful beast, that comes with a buff, when in danger once per day!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/v0bYLzU.png[/IMG][IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ayQtjtS.png[/IMG]

-ADDED Gem Exchanger (Eversun City x:163 y:307): Players can now trade 5 of one gem for one greater quality gem. Also, once per week a GM will setup a NPC that allows players to exchange the highest grade of a particular gem for other items.

-ADDED Casino Night Ticket: In Seizer's Palace, players may acquire a ticket that is used specifically for Casino Night events to trade for a special prize. This week's Casino Night, players may exchange the ticket as well as snowballs for prizes!

A further note about the Reincarnation System: We are adding in additional features regarding the Beast Transformation which players may see come about in the coming days.

notes.title: Version 8 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
The next version of DOMO is online! What do players have in store? Please have a look at the contents of the update:

NEW MAP: Sneaky Peak
This chilly mountainous map is home to many monsters that will challenge players and has new collection areas for collection connoisseurs to delve into.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/llOlVa0.png?1[/IMG]

NEW MAP: Firework Map
Players may visit this map in the southeast corner of Eversun City by the Player Community. On the Firework Map, players have a chance to spawn a boss monster if they set off Fireworks. If the boss is defeated, a chest drops which entitles the summoner access to its loot exclusively for three minutes. We have also fixed the firework notice so that it does not appear in the chat box.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/CI9LMAT.png?1[/IMG]

SYSTEM UPDATE: Revamped Equipment Mod and Upgrade System
Players may now maximize the potential out of their equipment by upgrading and modifying their equipment! We are well aware that this system was controversial in DOMO versions past so we took a sledge hammer to it and have heavily modified the system with the following changes:
-Most stats given by the mod system are percentage based instead of points in order to maintain the balance of classes
-Equipment pieces are no longer able to have the same stat be applied more than once per piece to prevent excessive stacking
-Certain stats can only be applied to certain pieces of equipment in order to cap how much of one stat bonus you may have
-While players are allowed to use upgraded items in the Arena, the stats awarded via the Mod system are disabled when in the arena.
-As we have made all these changes to the system, we have also halved the material requirements for both of these systems.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/FwwyiYG.png?1[/IMG]

NEW Items: Gold Weapons
Players may now purchase Gold Weapons to use at their disposal. We have also made a couple of changes to the Golden Wand, Syringe, Fan and Abacus to make them more balanced and so that they offer stat bonuses that would be more useful to the class that uses them.

NEW Items: Christmas Costumes
Players may now get into the Holiday spirit with Christmas themed costumes! Don't forget that we have some exciting surprises in store for players this month!

NEW Quests!
There are now new quests for players to take on including the Garnet Godwin fight! Visit the Emperor Gang Hideout to undertake this challenge.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Dream Of Mirror Online
notes.notes:
Dream Of Mirror Online is Now Available on Steam!

Behold an anime-themed land of wonders, friendship and skill, shrouded in the mysteries of an ancient world yours to explore. Forge relationships and find new friends, take up a job, or soar through the majestic skies as you rediscover a social MMORPG beloved by many around the world!



It is a time of myth and legend, where great heroes rise up to fight side by side, united against the instruments of destruction . Journey to a world linked by fate to another, a mirrored reflection of the chaos that has erupted within mankind. Reach for your destiny and become the hero you were meant to be, in Dream of Mirror Online!
